title: Velvety Norwegian Salmon Pasta
description: Indulge in this rich and creamy Norwegian salmon pasta, featuring tender salmon and velvety sauce, perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Preheat the sous vide water bath to 120 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the salmon fillets with salt, black pepper, and dried dill.
Seal the salmon fillets in a sous vide bag and cook for 20 minutes.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the fettuccine pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, melt the unsalted butter over medium heat and saute the chopped shallots and minced garlic until softened.
Add the heavy cream to the skillet and stir to combine with the shallot and garlic mixture.
Bring the cream mixture to a simmer and cook until slightly reduced, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the lemon zest and cook for an additional minute.
Remove the cooked salmon from the sous vide bag and flake into large pieces.
Add the cooked fettuccine pasta to the cream sauce and toss to combine.
Divide the pasta among plates and top with the flaked salmon.
